method: July DOE exports total 148.1 Bcf at Calcasieu Pass and Plaquemines; scaling the observed July daily rate over the 92-day quarter and multiplying by the empirical Q2 bridge (466.4 TBtu sold / 459.7 Bcf exported) gives a mean of 445.929 TBtu. I model reported volume with a normal distribution and subjective 30-TBtu standard deviation for unobserved August/September, commissioning changes, and an assumed stable export-to-sales/heating-value bridge; this uncertainty is not statistically fitted, and probabilities use an assumed 0.1-TBtu reporting step to handle strict exceedance. CP2 is excluded based on its stated 2027 first-LNG timing, and no later DOE monthly observation was located on the refreshed index. The report date of 2026-11-10 is expected, not announced, using a roughly three-month interval after the August 11 Q2 release.
